text:
maria-partnerships: pingSatya's HW marketplace team asked whether to send per-minute telemetry or hourly rollups. they keep hitting duplicate charge issues. quick thoughts? :thinking:

dan-ecosys: short answer: prefer hourly rollups for bulk reporting, minute-level only for low-latency features. we need a clear header to tell ingestion how to treat payloads.

nate-engr: agreed. propose header X-RW-Aggregation: none|minute|hour. if absent => treat as raw event stream (we'll rollup). require external_id on events for strong dedupe.

maria-partnerships: can you sketch the minimal contract we can paste in the partner doc?

nate-engr: pasted example below (curl + body). keep it tiny so partners copy/paste.

```bash
curl -X POST https://ingest.redwood.ai/v1/partner-usage \
  -H "Authorization: Signature keyId=partner-xyz,signature=\"...\"" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -H "X-RW-Aggregation: hour" \
  -d '[{"external_id":"dev-0001-20240601-00","device_id":"dev-0001","ts":"2024-06-01T00:00:00Z","units":3600,"unit_type":"seconds","sku_breakdown":[{"sku":"embed-basic","units":3600}]}]'
```

rachel-billing: from finance: hourly rows MUST include sku_breakdown OR a sku_key; otherwise our matching fails. we also need a daily file with totals for reconciliation (NDJSON gzip).

luis-sre: spike protection: we'll return 429 + Retry-After when a partner hits a rate cap. add X-Recommend-Batch-Size in response to guide them down.

dan-ecosys: what's our stance on late arrivals / clock drift? partners sometimes resend old events after device resets.

nate-engr: primary dedupe by external_id. if missing, dedupe by (device_id + ts). /* we prefer external_id. */ accept sequence_number too for ordering hints. if ts < now - 72h => respond 410 stale (configurable per partner).

luis-sre: we'll enforce per-partner ingestion TTL and post daily acceptance stats. reconcile-bot will surface rejects so partner ops can triage.

reconcile-bot: daily digest scheduled: partner-accepts.json.gz, rejected-sample.ndjson.gz, top-5-error-codes. will post to #partnerships/partner-ingest-summary at 05:30 UTC.

rachel-billing: reconciliation format: one gzipped NDJSON file per day with lines like `{"date":"2024-06-01","partner_id":"partner-xyz","sku":"embed-basic","units":3600}`. please include header X-Canonical-SHA256 with sha256 of canonical sorted lines.

maria-partnerships: good. also thinking of an onboarding escrow: partners preload a small credit buffer during first 48 hours so we don't block edge usage on legal paperwork. ops will refund unused automatically.

dan-ecosys: will add a small test feed and a script to validate checksum locally. ship that with the partner portal.

nate-engr: add sample partial-accept response so partners don't keep blind retrying:

HTTP/1.1 202 Accepted
Content-Type: application/json

{"accepted_count": 234, "rejected": [{"index": 4, "code": "SCHEMA_ERROR", "message": "missing sku_breakdown"}, {"index": 7, "code": "DUPLICATE", "message": "external_id already seen"}]}

maria-partnerships: nice. final checklist for the doc: 1) header contract (X-RW-Aggregation) 2) dedupe priority (external_id, then device+ts) 3) TTL policy (72h default) 4) rate guidance + 429 semantics 5) reconciliation NDJSON + sha256 checksum 6) escrow preload option 7) sample curl + partial-accept responses.

luis-sre: i'll add SLOs (ingest latency, daily processing window) and recommended token bucket numbers for bursts.

rachel-billing: i'll confirm the checksum canonicalization (sorting rules) and share a small matching script.

maria-partnerships: thanks everyone. i'll draft a one-page partner note and attach the test harness. please review tomorrow. :white_check_mark:
